summary:
Earth System Trend Detective is a project that helps us understand and monitor changes happening on Earth using satellite data, maps, graphs, and scientific observations.
Earth is continuously changing due to natural processes and human activities. These changes include global warming, climate change, deforestation, air pollution, water pollution, rising sea levels, and changes in rainfall patterns.
The main aim of this project is to collect and analyse Earth observation data to identify environmental trends and unusual changes. It uses satellite images and scientific datasets to study different environmental conditions over time.
